comparison_scope: SASS instructions, resources, EIATTR, ELF/PTX inventory and initialized device data. Only kernel names are normalized. Host comparisons apply to the before_move rows.
limits: A before_move match preserves the earlier build evidence; it does not turn an untested path into a GPU result.
B300_package rows compare with the earlier API test package, including cases which failed.
The archived-build device match has no direct link to a timed execution.
K64 comparisons here use x86 builds and the recorded-source rebuild. They do not establish equality with every Arm library. The separate B200 records retain their compiler and runtime scope.
